title: Mum asks: fake video
hook: Mum asked: is this video real?

beats.say: Mum sent a video of a film star selling a magic Diwali scheme.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta see this!! Film star says DOUBLE your money this Diwali!!

beats.say: A deepfake is a fake video made by AI. The face is real. The words are not.
Rule for Mum. If a famous face promises easy money, it's fake. Every time.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body:
Beta see this!! Film star says DOUBLE your money this Diwali!!

Ok. Forwarded your message to all 12 groups.

beats.say: She forwarded my warning to twelve groups.

caption:
mum got a deepfake. claude gave her one rule. it became the first useful forward in family group history.
